estimates: The garden boundary and outside paths come from the native map. Individual warehouse outlines, internal layout, wall heights, and the placement and profiles of roots and canopies are estimates using the published aggregate area and descriptions.

The modern wooden visitor walk, stairs and three black steel platforms are reconstructed at representative positions inside the surviving warehouse sector. The mapped continuation to the north gives the exit bearing. Fine roof remnants, mortar color and rail details are approximate.
The separately named merchant house, former residence, cafe, garden attractions and landscape beyond the old warehouse are outside scope.

review.notes: Qualla originals were screened first. The CC0 picture shows street food and the public-domain item is a separate museum. Additional Commons exterior records lack a qualifying release. The model uses the official descriptions, architect interview, current open map and native elevation field.
